profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp. is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, and trades under the ticker ZBRA. On its own site the company describes itself as a foundation for intelligent operations, saying it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate, and enhance processes with mobile computers, scanners, printers, and RFID. It also markets manufacturing technology solutions that combine hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

Its AI offerings, as described on the site, include Zebra Companion AI, which the company says offers instant, tailored insights and support for frontline work, and Zebra Frontline AI Enablers, which it describes as AI vision models, sample apps, and APIs for streamlining workflows. Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints are presented as adaptable AI frameworks that automate manual tasks in frontline operations. The Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software covers track-and-trace, vision inspection, and industrial automation, and Zebra Aurora Focus is a single interface for setting up, deploying, and running the company's Fixed Industrial Scanners and Machine Vision Smart Cameras. Zebra says its AI is an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

The company's profile lists it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0000877212. Its litigation record counts 339 matters in Illinois. No individual cases, tracked products, or MCP servers are listed for it.
